title: The result notification
text: A result notification arrives just as you were putting the phone away.
results: I let the notification pass and kept the pause in my plan.
The notification became another betting session.
A support conversation helped me leave the notification unopened.

title: The losing streak
text: Recent losses make a promised fresh start feel tempting.
results: I accepted the loss instead of treating another bet as recovery.
Trying to recover earlier losses added a new loss.
Talking through the losses helped me keep them separate from today's decision.

title: The familiar invitation
text: Someone mentions a gambling night you used to look forward to.
results: I declined that invitation while keeping room for other company.
The familiar invitation brought me back to the tables.
Support helped me arrange company away from the gambling night.

title: The empty evening
text: An unplanned evening brings the familiar pull of a wager.
results: I let the empty evening stay empty instead of filling it with a bet.
The spare evening turned into another gambling bill.
A check-in helped me choose a different use for the evening.

title: The saved basket
text: A saved shopping basket reappears after a difficult day.
results: I left the basket unfinished and let the difficult day settle.
The saved basket became another purchase I had not planned.
Talking through the day helped me leave the basket alone.

title: The limited offer
text: An offer is about to expire, and waiting suddenly feels costly.
results: I allowed the offer to expire without turning urgency into a purchase.
The deadline persuaded me to buy things I had not needed before it appeared.
Support helped me separate the offer's deadline from my own needs.

title: The delivery trail
text: Several parcels remind you how quickly small purchases accumulate.
results: I paused the next order after looking at what had already arrived.
More parcels added to the spending I had been avoiding looking at.
A check-in made the accumulated spending easier to face without another order.

title: The comparison spiral
text: Looking at other people's purchases makes your own life feel smaller.
results: I stepped away from the comparison without buying a different identity.
Comparison led to purchases that did not fix how I felt.
Support helped me talk about the comparison rather than answer it with a purchase.

title: The unfinished shift
text: The shift has ended, but an unfinished task keeps you at the desk.
results: I left a clear handover and let the shift end.
The handover became another night of unpaid strain.
A check-in helped me agree a stopping point.

title: The family date
text: A family date clashes with work you could postpone.
results: I protected the family date and rescheduled the work.
Work took the family date and strained trust.
Support helped me share a realistic schedule with my family.

title: The praise trap
text: Praise for always being available makes saying no feel dangerous.
results: I accepted the praise without promising every evening.
I traded more rest for being the person who never says no.
Talking it through helped me separate my worth from constant availability.

title: The silent weekend
text: A quiet weekend leaves you reaching for work out of habit.
results: I let the weekend be useful without turning it into another shift.
The weekend disappeared into work and exhaustion.
A support call helped me make room for life outside work.

title: The familiar round
text: An ordinary gathering turns into a familiar offer of another drink.
results: I kept my boundary and stayed for the company.
Another round brought back the familiar costs and fatigue.
A check-in helped me stay with the gathering without another round.

title: The hard evening
text: After a hard evening, the old routine feels like the easiest comfort.
results: I let the difficult evening pass without returning to that routine.
The old comfort added expense and wear to a difficult evening.
Support helped me find company through the hard evening.

title: The celebration toast
text: A celebration puts an unwanted drink in front of you.
results: I joined the celebration while keeping my own boundary.
The toast became an evening beyond what I had planned.
Someone helped me keep the celebration separate from drinking.

title: The cupboard reminder
text: A familiar bottle remains in the cupboard after an earlier gathering.
results: I stepped away from the reminder and kept my plan.
The reminder became another night of drinking.
A check-in helped me change the routine around that reminder.

title: The old contact
text: An old contact gets back in touch after a stressful week.
results: I left the contact unanswered and kept my boundary.
The contact renewed spending and harm I had been trying to leave behind.
Support helped me get through the contact without accepting the offer.

title: The difficult morning
text: A difficult morning makes an old escape feel immediate.
results: I stayed with the morning and let the urge pass.
The escape added expense and health strain to the morning.
A support conversation gave the morning a different direction.

title: The familiar place
text: Returning to a familiar place brings back a routine you are trying to change.
results: I changed the visit and kept the routine from restarting.
The place brought back the familiar costs and strain.
Support helped me find a different way to spend the visit.

title: The unanswered worry
text: A worry you have avoided returns when you are alone.
results: I faced the worry without returning to the old escape.
Avoiding the worry brought back the habit and its consequences.
A check-in helped me name the worry and stay with my recovery.

title: The afterparty
text: An invitation arrives just as the evening could reasonably end.
results: I ended the evening before it became another lost night.
The afterparty took money, rest and the following morning.
Support helped me make a plan for going home.

title: The weekend invitation
text: A crowded weekend calendar makes rest feel like missing out.
results: I kept one evening for rest without abandoning my friends.
The packed weekend left more bills and exhaustion.
A check-in helped me keep company and rest in the same plan.

title: The last-minute guest list
text: A last-minute guest list makes an ordinary night feel like a rare chance.
results: I let the guest list pass and protected the next day.
The rare chance became another familiar recovery day.
Support helped me judge the invitation against the week I actually needed.

title: The quiet group chat
text: A quiet group chat makes you want to organise another late night.
results: I suggested company that did not cost another sleepless night.
Another late night added spending and fatigue to the week.
A check-in helped me choose a calmer way to see people.
